title: MZ MAKING A COOL SPECIAL INTERACTIONS PLUGIN

posts.author: smileking
posts.body:
So this plugin for rpg maker MZ will be a little fun plugin where i plan to add as many special interactions i need and don't want to use so many variables to manually make these functions for my game.
WHAT DOES THIS PLUGIN DO?
This plugin will have a feature called CheckEnemy where it will be able to discern if you want it to check only enemy health, only enemy stats, only show status effects, or you can make it just show everything
This plugin will have a feature called CoinFlip where it will be able to use the chosen party member's luck for both the coin flip, and and the amount of reward, it will be based on if you land on heads or tails, heads is success, and you set the basis values of the lowest and highest, and you get to decide the luck divider
HOW MUCH WILL THIS PLUGIN COST?
Like all my plugins it will cost nothing but with the option to donate
IS THIS FOR COMMERCIAL PROJECTS?
Yes this plugin is free for non commercial and commercial projects with no actual incentive to even credit me, all i ask is you keep the MIT license with it
IS THIS MY LAST POST HERE?
As we near the end of the forum I have some things to say, I will be reposting everything on the new site eventually, and I also want to say thank you, the community support i've gotten, and the fact that i've gotten to give free opportunity's with these plugins, that as far as i could see, every other option comes with money issues to go with them, SO HAVE A GREAT SUMMER, A GREAT YEAR, AND HOPEFULLY WE ALL MEET AGAIN ON THE NEW FORUM!
